title: Among female patients born between 1980 and 1989 who have abnormal platelet
question: Among female patients born between 1980 and 1989 who have abnormal platelet levels, how many also exhibit either an abnormal fibrinogen level or a positive anti-scl70 test result?

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_058")
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
  AND T2."XCL_027" NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND (T2."XCL_036" NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 400 OR T2."XCL_051" NOT IN ('negative', '0'))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_058" AS "__grain_value_0" FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014" WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' AND NOT T2."XCL_027" BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND (NOT T2."XCL_036" BETWEEN 200 AND 400 OR NOT T2."XCL_051" IN ('negative', '0'))) AS __ontology_entity_grain
